test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the single percentage discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 30%, 20% and 10%.
solution:
**Given:**

Three successive discounts: 30%, 20%, and 10%

**Formula used:**

Single equivalent discount (D) formula:

D = 100 × (1 - (1 - d₁/100) × (1 - d₂/100) × (1 - d₃/100))

**Calculation:**

D = 100 × (1 - (1 - 30/100) × (1 - 20/100) × (1 - 10/100))

⇒ D = 100 × (1 - 0.70 × 0.80 × 0.90)

⇒ D = 100 × (1 - 0.504)

⇒ D = 100 × 0.496

⇒ D = 49.6%

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
